title: Heterogeneous biased sign distribution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $p_i\in(0,1)$ for each coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The heterogeneous biased sign distribution on sign vectors of length $n$ is the product probability distribution whose coordinate $i$ has the biased sign distribution with parameter $p_i$.
hypotheses_covered: Each coordinate parameter $p_i$ lies strictly between $0$ and $1$
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the one-coordinate biased sign distribution, so the precise meaning of its parameter cannot be specified.
